_comment: Claude Desktop / MCP client config for the PocMap MCP server (22 tools, 3 resources, 3 prompts). Merge the 'mcpServers' block into your client's config file. The '_comment'/'_instructions' keys are ignored by the client and exist only as documentation.
_instructions: 1. Preferred: uvx (requires uv on PATH). No local clone — installs pocmap[server] from PyPI and runs pocmap-mcp.
2. Alternate (already installed): command pocmap-mcp with args [].
3. Alternate (module): command python, args ["-m", "pocmap.mcp_server"] after pip install "pocmap[server]".
4. Config file location — macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json ; Windows: %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
5. The env tokens are optional but raise API rate limits; omit or leave blank to run unauthenticated.
6. Restart Claude Desktop after editing. The server speaks STDIO by default.
7. Optional version pin: last arg pocmap-mcp@X.Y.Z (that release must ship the pocmap-mcp console script).
